system.description:
The maritime killers of the Jinia Isles and the Opal waterfront: a merchant face-down in the harbour, a captain who never reached his cabin.

  • Unsteady Ground: a creature that is swimming, in water above its knees, or on ice, a ledge or a pitching deck counts as unable to see you for your Sneak Attack. You climb and swim at full speed.
    • 9th level: when you hit a creature on unsteady ground, it makes a Reflex save against your Class Save DC or falls Prone (or into the water).
  • Sea Cover: Advantage on Disguise checks to pass as a sailor, docker or maritime merchant, and on checks to dispose of evidence at sea.
